Class AbstractDBRepository<ID, E extends Entity<ID>>

java.lang.Object
com.lab.repository.db.AbstractDBRepository<ID,E>
Type Parameters:
ID - the type of the entity's identifier
E - the type of the entity, which must extend Entity
All Implemented Interfaces:
Repository<ID,E>
Direct Known Subclasses:
FriendshipDBRepository, UserDBRepository
public abstract class AbstractDBRepository<ID, E extends Entity<ID>> extends Object implements Repository<ID,E>
Abstract base class for the JDBC database repositories (Template Method). It implements every Repository operation once: it opens the connection, prepares the statement, executes it, reads the result and wraps any SQLException into a RepositoryException. The subclasses only provide the SQL text and the conversion between table rows and entities

    • readGeneratedIds

      protected void readGeneratedIds(ResultSet resultSet, E entity) throws SQLException
      Copies the identifier generated by the database onto the entity that was just saved. The default implementation does nothing, for entities whose id is not generated; repositories of entities with a generated id override it
      Parameters:
      resultSet - the generated keys, positioned on the inserted row
      entity - the entity that was just saved
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the generated key cannot be read
